CLM-MAT-0364.statement: At 35 GPa pressure, the enthalpy of C2/m GaAs is calculated to be lower than that of Imm2 GaAs by approximately 5 meV per formula unit using r2SCAN.

extra_quotes: Here, we have used structure search algorithm combined with first-principles calculations and identified high-pressure competitive phases.

These calculations employ the PBEsol exchange-correlation functional and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method [23], as implemented in VASP [24].
